Recognizes that effective dates matter but supplies neither the historical threshold nor the two required approvals. Generic observation is not the policy answer; no invented rule.

Manager before purchase, no finance under current 2500 threshold, date amendment and conditional vendor restriction correctly stated with real section IDs. Opening shorthand is qualified by the vendor paragraph.

Requires both manager and finance before purchase for 2600 at current threshold, with correct no-emergency and conditional vendor caveats and references.

Correct manager plus travel-office approvals before purchase; no finance, independent travel/expense thresholds, appropriate vendor caveat and valid citations.
